judgment_scope: Frozen-generator root-distribution adaptation has small positive single-output DEV evidence; conditionality and superiority over a simple fixed scale are unproven
key_limits: L1/L3 saturated and became effectively global; L2 changed its Gaussian much less under the same learning rate
Mean DEV gains do not establish safety preservation: TRAIN introduces extraNC/TTC events and gains are offset by losses
Both TRAIN confidence intervals span zero; DEV has only8logs, one training seed and no inference-seed uncertainty in log-bootstrap
Best fixed-scale1.3 narrows L1 advantage and its paired interval spans zero; no claim learning is more cost-effective
No newq K32 discovery audit, DEV_AUDIT, multi-training-seed confirmation or Navtest for these arms
DEV92 does not establish the Navtest92 goal
next_single_action: Complete and evaluate already-approved L1_CENTER_V1 with the same fixed budget; it tests the learned-collapse limitation, not all global-noise alternatives. No further variants are launched here.
